title: mono: core-shell, billing, reports pass owner from package.json team

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty/non-string; core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner matching package.json team (hardcoded literals, since apps are bundled without JSON imports). All three apps build locally; PR #1 CI+CD green. Assumption: single PR in mono since shared-contracts is an in-repo lib inlined at build; platform-kit untouched.
